description: This bar chart illustrates Recall@10 values for different interaction methods. The horizontal axis displays the categories: “- critiquing”, “- scoring”, and “- ranking”, presented in an unspecified order and with labels rotated for readability. The vertical axis, labeled “Recall@10”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.4, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. There are three orange bars, the first of which, corresponding to the first category, reaches approximately 0.33. The second and third bars are blue, representing the “- scoring” and “- ranking” categories respectively, with heights of approximately 0.28 and 0.23. No bars are visually emphasized, and there are no groupings or stacking present.
